evidence: HfO2 gate dielectrics were grown on n-type Si substrates by atomic layer deposition using alternating cycles of HfCl4 and H2O with N2 carrier gas. A post-deposition anneal in O2 at 700 °C for 60 s was carried out. 20 nm thick TiN capping layers were deposited by ALD using TiCl4 and NH3 at 350 °C followed by another 20 nm of TiN grown by DC sputtering.
